messages:
Maya: Hi payroll team  I had a short relocation from CA to ON in Sep and my Nov vesting shows a huge withholding line labeled 'Non-resident Tax' even though my payroll country is Canada. Did we apply US tax rules by mistake?
Omar (Payroll): Thanks for flagging Maya. Quick Q: were the equity proceeds paid to a US bank or a Canadian bank? That can change the payout path.
Maya: Paid to my Canadian account (TD). Workday shows country CA. Vesting event 11/15 net pay printed as CAD 12,000 gross, withheld CAD 4,800 "Non-resident tax".
Claire (TaxOps): That label sounds wrong for a Canadian resident. Possible causes: 1) the equity payout element was set to 'USD global' triggering US supplemental withholding, or 2) the relocation record created a transient non-resident profile. We'll need the grant/vesting doc and the payslip.
Maya: Uploaded payslip and grant doc to case PR-2026-999. Case created via portal.
Omar (Payroll): Action: I'll triage the run config and check element currency. If withholding was mis-applied we'll process a correcting entry and coordinate with Canadian tax filings (CRA). If needed we'll reissue a T4 or amendment.
PeopleOps Bot: Case PR-2026-999 created and routed to team:intl-equity. ETA initial review 3 business days.
Maya: Appreciate it. If corrected withholding can't be posted until next run, can we get an interim gross-up so my cashflow isn't hit?
Omar (Payroll): We can request a one-time reimbursement/gross-up in the next payroll while remittance corrections are filed. We'll confirm after triage.
Claire (TaxOps): We'll also prepare a short note for your accountant explaining the correction and timeline, and whether a T4 amendment will be issued.
Maya: Thanks  leaving open until resolved :pray:
